classifications.description: Information that can be accessed by everyone, including external parties, customers, partners, and the public.
classifications.access_requirement: No authentication or special authorization required. Freely distributable externally.
example_document_types: Public product documentation
Open-source software guidelines
Public press releases and corporate announcements
Published privacy statements and external compliance certifications
Customer-facing API reference manuals

handling_requirements.storage: May reside on public CDNs, marketing web servers, or unauthenticated documentation repositories.
handling_requirements.transmission: Plaintext transfer acceptable, though HTTPS/TLS standard is recommended.
handling_requirements.labeling: Must be tagged with 'PUBLIC' in document headers or metadata registries.
handling_requirements.encryption_at_rest: Optional; standard enterprise storage encryption applies by default.

classifications.description: Information intended for authenticated employees and authorized contractors of Threshold Enterprise Systems. Not intended for public dissemination.
classifications.access_requirement: Valid enterprise authentication (SSO / corporate identity credentials). Granted to all active enterprise roles.
example_document_types: General employee handbooks
Standard operating guidelines and workplace policies
Company-wide town hall presentations and strategic overviews
Internal architectural overviews and standard software practices
IT helpdesk self-service guides and onboarding checklists

handling_requirements.storage: Internal corporate document management systems, intranet repositories, and secure wiki spaces.
handling_requirements.transmission: Mandatory encryption in transit via TLS 1.3. External sharing prohibited without management approval.
handling_requirements.labeling: Header banner: 'INTERNAL - FOR THRESHOLD ENTERPRISE SYSTEMS USE ONLY'.
handling_requirements.encryption_at_rest: AES-256 encryption required on all enterprise storage backends.

classifications.description: Information accessible only to authorized departments, management roles, or explicitly permitted users due to operational or proprietary business sensitivity.
classifications.access_requirement: Department-scoped role membership (e.g. DEPT-ENG for engineering confidential documents, DEPT-HR for HR confidential documents) or management-tier clearance.
example_document_types: Proprietary AI model training recipes and algorithmic weights documentation
Unreleased product architecture specifications and engineering runbooks
Departmental operational budgets and financial forecasts
Employee compensation bands and departmental performance reviews
Enterprise AI governance audit logs and risk assessment scorecards

handling_requirements.storage: Restricted departmental storage partitions with role-based access control (RBAC) enforcement.
handling_requirements.transmission: End-to-end encrypted transit with strict DLP (Data Loss Prevention) monitoring.
handling_requirements.labeling: Header banner: 'CONFIDENTIAL - STRICT DEPARTMENTAL ACCESS RESTRICTIONS APPLY'.
handling_requirements.encryption_at_rest: AES-256 encryption with compartmentalized key management per department.

classifications.description: Highly sensitive information accessible only to explicitly authorized roles and designated individuals under strict need-to-know controls.
classifications.access_requirement: Explicit role authorization (e.g. ADMIN or SECURITY_ENGINEER with explicit security scope entitlement). No implicit or default access.
example_document_types: Active cybersecurity incident response forensics and exploit vectors
Enterprise cryptographic root keys and infrastructure zero-day runbooks
Executive M&A strategy documents and material non-public financial records
Red team penetration testing vulnerability playbooks and threat actor dossiers
Regulatory enforcement inquiry briefings and legal privilege disclosures

handling_requirements.storage: Dedicated air-gapped or high-security vaults with immutable audit logging and zero-standing privileges.
handling_requirements.transmission: Encrypted with dedicated envelope encryption keys; copy/paste and export capabilities disabled.
handling_requirements.labeling: Header banner: 'RESTRICTED - STRICT NEED-TO-KNOW CLEARANCE REQUIRED - AUDITED ACCESS'.
handling_requirements.encryption_at_rest: Hardware Security Module (HSM) backed customer-managed keys with dual-custody authorization.
